Module com.example.cab302_project
Package com.app.studysnap.model

Class Quiz

java.lang.Object
com.app.studysnap.model.Quiz
public class Quiz extends Object
An object class representing a quiz with metadata and a list of Questions.

A quiz belongs to a creator (via createdBy), can be marked as private/public, and can include a subject, title, and description.

      public Quiz(int quizId, String title, String subject, String description, boolean is_private, int createdBy)
      Constructs a Quiz with all persisted fields populated.
      Parameters:
      quizId - The unique identifier of the quiz (database primary key)
      title - The title of the quiz
      subject - The quiz subject or category
      description - A short description of the quiz (can be null)
      is_private - Whether the quiz is private (true) or public (false)
      createdBy - The user id of the quiz creator
